title.narrative: Grant for the DCFTA Initiative East - Local Currency Solution Programme

description.narrative: Under this project, the EIB will make available a subsidized synthetic loan to Partner Financial Institutions (PFIs), which will be disbursed and repaid in EUR. In parallel, the Bank will close a non-deliverable cross currency swap with hedging counterparts based on the theoretic local currency cash-flow, and will receive a set EUR cash-flow.
